description: This file defines the PerformanceReview entity class used in the OrangeHRM performance module, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations and traits to manage performance review data, including properties, relationships, and metadata.

classes.name: PerformanceReview
classes.description: Entity class representing a performance review, with fields for status, review period, dates, comments, ratings, relationships to employee, job title, subunit, and reviewers, using Doctrine ORM for database mapping, and methods for property access and modification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the performance review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the performance review.

methods.name: getStatusId
methods.description: Returns the status identifier of the review (inactive, activated, in progress, completed).

methods.name: setStatusId
methods.description: Sets the status identifier of the review.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the review period.

methods.name: setReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Sets the start date of the review period.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the review period.

methods.name: setReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Sets the end date of the review period.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Retrieves the due date for the performance review.

methods.name: setDueDate
methods.description: Sets the due date for the review.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the completion date of the review.

methods.name: getActivatedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the activation date of the review.

methods.name: setActivatedDate
methods.description: Sets the activation date of the review.

methods.name: getFinalComment
methods.description: Retrieves the final comments associated with the review.

methods.name: setFinalComment
methods.description: Sets the final comments for the review.

methods.name: getFinalRate
methods.description: Retrieves the final rating score of the review.

methods.name: setFinalRate
methods.description: Sets the final rating score.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the job title related to the review.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a job title with the review.

methods.name: getSubunit
methods.description: Returns the subunit associated with the review.

methods.name: setSubunit
methods.description: Associates a subunit with the review.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee being reviewed.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with the review.

methods.name: getReviewers
methods.description: Returns the list of reviewers involved in the review.

methods.name: setReviewers
methods.description: Sets the list of reviewers for the review.
